info.brief: Functions and constants for using webrtc.
info.description: Functions and constants for using webrtc.

elements.name: webrtc.set_configuration
elements.description: Sets the configuration for the peer connection

parameters.name: ice_servers
parameters.doc: A string containg a list of stun or turn servers (eg "stun_url:PORT;turn_url:PORT:USER:PASSWORD"), a section is delimited by ';' and subdivided by ':'

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The script instance that was used to register the callback

fields.name: event
fields.doc:
The current event. One of the following
- `webrtc.EVENT_CHANNEL_OPENED`
- `webrtc.EVENT_CHANNEL_CLOSED`
- `webrtc.EVENT_SIGNALING_DATA`
- `webrtc.EVENT_MESSAGE`

fields.name: id
fields.doc: the id of the sender peer, not present if event is `webrtc.EVENT_SIGNALING_DATA`.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: the label of the DataChannel, not present if event is `webrtc.EVENT_SIGNALING_DATA`.

fields.name: msg
fields.doc: the message sent from the peer, only present if event is `webrtc.EVENT_MESSAGE`.

fields.name: signaling
fields.doc: the signaling data to send to the other peer, only present if event is `webrtc.EVENT_SIGNALING_DATA`.

elements.name: webrtc.process_data
elements.description: Processes the signaling data that was received by a peer.

parameters.name: data
parameters.doc: The data that needs to be processed.

elements.name: webrtc.create_channel
elements.description: Creates a datachannel with a specified peer and type

parameters.name: id
parameters.doc: The id for which the datachannel is to be created

parameters.name: type
parameters.doc: The type of the datachannel, it can be any of the TYPE_* constants

elements.name: webrtc.send_message
elements.description: Sends a message to a peer by a channel

parameters.name: id
parameters.doc: The id to which the message is to be sent

parameters.name: label
parameters.doc: The label of the channel to be used, the datachannel needs to be already created
